name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature, enhancement, or improvement for NumCompute-Stream.
title: "[FEATURE]"

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are facing while using NumCompute-Stream.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of the feature, enhancement, or functionality you would like to see added.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, workarounds, or features you have considered.

**Use Case**
Describe how this feature would improve your workflow or benefit NumCompute-Stream users.

**Additional context**
Add any other context, references, benchmarks, or screenshots related to the feature request here.

### Checklist

* [ ] I have searched existing issues before creating this request.
* [ ] This feature would benefit multiple NumCompute-Stream users.
* [ ] I have clearly described the proposed enhancement.
* [ ] I am willing to contribute to the implementation (optional).
